overview.description: The State Street SPDR S&P Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (XOP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in energy equity. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of companies in the US oil & gas exploration & production space. XOP was launched on Jun 19, 2006 and is issued by State Street.
